title: Dengue Virus NS2B-NS3 Protease Co-Expression and Purification Protocol
author: korvus.wang
materials: See Materials tab for buffer compositions. DENV2 NS2B-NS3 His6-StrepII fusion protein properties Before tag cleavage: MW = 32.812 kDa E (assume all Cys reduced)= 51340 mM-1cm-1 pI = 5.47 After tag cleavage: NS2B MW = 5.0635 kDa E(assume all Cys reduced) = 6990 PI = 3.98 NS3 MW = 18.096 kDa E(assume all Cys reduced) = 30940 PI = 6.73 These values are estimated by Expasy ProtParam Thaw and resuspend the pellet in ~7mL of lysis buffer per g of pellet. Stir gently with magnetic stir bar at Room temperature for 00:30:00 to allow lysozyme and bezonase to start breaking down cell components.
Elution de-salting, tag cleavage and reverse IMAC

steps.title: Prepare starter from glycerol stock
steps.instruction: Scrape a small amount of the DVNS2B3 glycerol stock with a sterile loop and inoculate 10 mL LB broth containing 50 µg/mL kanamycin in a 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Grow starter overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the starter culture at 37 °C with shaking at 200 rpm overnight.

steps.title: Inoculate production TB media
steps.instruction: Use the 10 mL starter to inoculate each 1 L of TB medium (supplemented with 50 µg/mL kanamycin) in a baffled flask; grow at 37 °C, 200 rpm. For this protocol two 1 L flasks (total 2 L) are prepared, yielding ~33 g cell pellet after harvest.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: When the culture reaches OD₆₀₀ ≈ 1.8, add IPTG to a final concentration of 1 mM, lower the temperature to 18 °C and the shaker speed to 180 rpm, and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 4 000 × g, 4 °C for 30 min. Discard the supernatant, flash‑freeze the cell pellet and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Lyse cells by sonication
steps.instruction: Thaw the pellet on ice, resuspend in lysis buffer, and sonicate with a cycle of 4 s on / 12 s off at 50 % amplitude for a total on‑time of 7 min while keeping the sample cold.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysed suspension at 38 000 × g, 4 °C for 1 h. Collect the clear supernatant and keep it on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Ni‑Sepharose resin
steps.instruction: Dispense 3 mL Ni‑Sepharose 6 FF (Cytiva) into a gravity‑flow column, rinse sequentially with ~10 column volumes (CV) of distilled water followed by ~10 CV of binding buffer to remove storage solution.

steps.title: Bind lysate to resin
steps.instruction: Resuspend the equilibrated resin in ~10 mL binding buffer, add it to the clarified supernatant, and incubate for 30 min at 4 °C with gentle rotation.

steps.title: Load resin and collect flow‑through
steps.instruction: Load the resin‑lysate mixture onto the gravity‑flow column, collect the flow‑through, and set aside 15 µL of each flow‑through sample mixed with 5 µL 4× SDS‑PAGE sample buffer containing 10 mM DTT for later analysis.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Wash the column sequentially with 10 CV of base buffer, then 10 CV of wash buffer 1, and finally 10 CV of wash buffer 2, allowing each wash to pass completely before the next. Collect each wash fraction separately for SDS‑PAGE.

steps.title: Elute target protein
steps.instruction: Elute the bound protein with 2.5 CV of elution buffer; repeat the elution once more to obtain a total of two elution fractions.

steps.title: Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the A₂₈₀ of each elution fraction using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer (e.g., E1 = 18.28 mg/mL, E2 = 13.02 mg/mL) to estimate protein content.

steps.title: Desalt pooled elutions
steps.instruction: Pool the two elution fractions and run them through a HiPrep 26/10 desalting column on the AKTA Pure system at the maximum flow rate of 10 mL/min to remove imidazole.

steps.title: Cleave affinity tags with His‑TEV
steps.instruction: Add His‑TEV protease to the desalted sample at a 1:100 (protease:protein) mass ratio as determined by NanoDrop, and incubate at 4 °C (cold room) overnight.

steps.title: Remove cleaved tag by reverse IMAC
steps.instruction: The next day, pour the protease‑treated sample over the previously washed Ni‑Sepharose resin, collect the flow‑through (target protein), and repeat this binding‑wash step three times to capture the cleaved His‑tag and any uncleaved protein.

steps.title: Wash reverse‑IMAC resin
steps.instruction: Wash the resin with 2 CV of wash buffer 1 followed by 2 CV of wash buffer 2; collect the washes and flow‑through for SDS‑PAGE analysis.

steps.title: Concentrate target protein
steps.instruction: Using 10 kDa MWCO spin concentrators, concentrate the pooled flow‑through fractions to a final volume of < 5 mL.

steps.title: Clarify concentrate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the concentrate at 17 200 × g, 4 °C for 10 min, then carefully withdraw the supernatant with a 5 mL syringe and blunt‑tip fill needle, avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: Size‑exclusion chromatography
steps.instruction: Inject the clarified sample onto a HiLoad 16/60 Superdex 75 pg column using the AKTA Pure system (5 mL sample loop) at 1 mL/min in gel‑filtration buffer, collecting 1 mL fractions.

steps.title: Analyze and pool SEC fractions
steps.instruction: Run SDS‑PAGE on all SEC fractions; identify fractions containing the target (e.g., E10‑F4). Pool these fractions for final concentration.

steps.title: Final concentration and storage
steps.instruction: Concentrate the pooled SEC fractions in a Vivaspin 500 10 kDa MWCO concentrator until the protein reaches > 23 mg/mL or 1 mM. Take 1 µL for SDS‑PAGE and another for mass spectrometry, aliquot the remainder, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Store used Ni resin
steps.instruction: Wash the used IMAC resin with 10 CV of base buffer, leave the column submerged in a small amount of base buffer to keep the resin moist for future reverse‑IMAC reuse.

steps.title: Optional resin binding test
steps.instruction: (Optional) Elute the stored resin with 2 CV of elution buffer to assess whether any protein remains bound to the Ni matrix.
